docs.text: This page provides the API reference for the cloudmesh-ai-backup library.

docs.title: backup_cmd
docs.text:
backup_cmd()

Backup command that only prints to the console.

Source code in src/cloudmesh/ai/command/backup.py 
@click.command()
def backup_cmd():
    """
    Backup command that only prints to the console.
    """
    console.print("Backup command executed successfully.")

docs.title: register
docs.text:
register(cli)

Registers the backup command with the main CLI.

Source code in src/cloudmesh/ai/command/backup.py 
def register(cli):
    """
    Registers the backup command with the main CLI.
    """
    cli.add_command(backup_cmd, name="backup")

docs.title: Cloudmesh AI Backup
docs.text: Cloudmesh AI Backup is a specialized utility within the Cloudmesh AI ecosystem designed to provide robust backup and recovery capabilities for AI infrastructure, configurations, and datasets.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: In the complex environment of AI clusters and HPC nodes, maintaining consistent backups of configuration files, model weights, and orchestration scripts is critical. cloudmesh-ai-backup provides a standardized way to execute backup operations across the ecosystem.

docs.title: Key Features
docs.text:
• Integrated CLI: Seamlessly integrates with the cmc (Cloudmesh AI Command) interface.
  • Ecosystem Aware: Designed to work with other cloudmesh-ai-* tools to ensure all critical AI infrastructure components are captured.
  • Consistent Interface: Follows the standardized Cloudmesh AI patterns for logging, I/O, and configuration.

docs.title: 1. Install the Core CLI
docs.text:
Ensure you have the central orchestrator installed: 

pip install cloudmesh-ai-cmc

docs.title: Usage
docs.text: The backup functionality is exposed as a command within the cmc utility.

docs.title: Development
docs.text:
If you are contributing to the backup tool, use the provided Makefile for common tasks:

  • Install in editable mode: 
    make install
  • Run Tests: 
    make test
  • Build Documentation: 
    make doc
